page.layout: One printed page, single column of running text with a centred italic subheading and a diagram in the lower half; the cross-diagram of the multiplication check sits at the right beside the first worked example. Running head at top. No margin notes. Page number at top left.

page.notes: The check cross-diagram at the right (7 at top, 2 and 8 at sides, 7 at bottom) is a multiplication check diagram; the worked example 89 × 2 = 178 is set beside it. The small star-like marks in the lower block are printed check symbols, transcribed approximately. "Quid" at the bottom right is a catchword. The text "multiplicando" and "multiplicato" are printed as shown. Some letters on the scan are faint, notably in "multiplicatorem" and "remanent", but they are legible. The diagram in the lower block is rendered only approximately; the exact arrangement of the star marks could not be fully confirmed.
